welcomeContinuity.decision: Preserve the exact visible welcome as one ordinary assistant bubble after first send.

figma.operation: Figma Find/Replace: six exact full-text matches on This page; replaced 6 results; full replacement subsequently matched 6 results.

regression.baseline: Existing failed-first-send regression and new named-welcome lifecycle regression both failed before the fix because the visible greeting was replaced by the compact copy.
regression.result: 96 tests passed; targeted flutter analyze and contract validation passed.
assertions: Full welcome content equals the profile greeting, with assistant role and ordinary bubble state.
Exactly one welcome remains before the first user message through failed send, retry, streaming, completed reply, follow-ups, disconnect and resume.
No layout exceptions at widths 320/390/430 and text scales 1x/2x.
regression.goldens: 36 affected conversation-state baselines refreshed. One home-320-1x baseline refreshed after waiting for visible image providers, fixing an existing navigation-image loading race; the other five home baselines remain byte-identical.

knownLimits: Full-page visual parity is not claimed: existing background, avatar, typography/line-height, button and navigation differences remain.

The lifecycle capture includes preceding turns for terminal-error, disconnected-partial and resumed, and a different draft in disconnected-empty. Those full-page captures are behavioral evidence and were not compared as aligned Figma fixtures.
Validation used Flutter widget rendering; no device build, installation or release was performed.

conversationRecovery.decision: Restore the current owned conversation, or discover the latest owned conversation when none is selected, then open at the latest content without inserting a synthetic assistant message.

localRecoveryState: rendered transcript cache keyed by durable message identity

regression.flutter: 117 combined targeted Flutter tests passed, including the 8 focused conversation-recovery cases; targeted flutter analyze passed.
regression.runtime: 31 targeted pytest cases, Ruff, and MyPy passed.
assertions: Every page return refreshes the current conversation, or discovers the latest conversation when none is selected, and lands at the latest content.
Cold restart restores the draft and cached conversation at the latest content.
Older pages deduplicate durable IDs and preserve the current viewport.
A reply arriving while the user is browsing older messages does not pull the viewport to the bottom and exposes only the ordinary latest-message control.
Late history responses cannot overwrite a newer local turn or its draft.
Foreign or deleted threads return 404 before message reads.

knownLimits: Behavior captures intentionally exercise longer transcripts for pagination, so their fixture data does not exactly match the compact Figma examples.
Comparison metrics are diagnostic only; full-page pixel parity is not claimed.
Validation used Flutter widget rendering and the live Figma file; no device installation or release was performed.

attachmentMenuEvidence.note: The attachment menu component was compared at 220x156; full-page attachment states remain separately limited.
